units.source_text: 提起伊莎·特莱密，这当然是埃及妇女的名字。

en.t: Speaking of Isa Tlemi, that is of course the name of an Egyptian woman.

units.source_text: 她姑娘时代的名字叫玛格丽特·斯图尔特，

en.t: Her name as a girl was Margaret Stewart,

units.source_text: 正如这个名字所显示的那样，她本是个美国姑娘。

en.t: and as that name suggests, she was originally an American girl.

units.source_text: 从一个美国野丫头成长为今天的特莱密夫人，其中有一段奇异的浪漫史。

en.t: In her transformation from a wild American girl into the Mrs. Tlemi of today, there lay a strange romance.
